Rep. Casar: US Needs to Put the Brakes on Advanced AI
videos.description: Rep. Greg Casar, chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, discusses legislation he is proposing with Sen. Bernie Sanders that would permanently ban artificial superintelligence, temporarily pause advanced AI development, and establish a new federal AI regulator. Casar says companies should be barred from pursuing artificial superintelligence, while research on AI that is safe and beneficial could continue. He also discusses divisions among House Democrats and the role of the Progressive Caucus if Democrats win control of the chamber. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Parents Push Teens to Start Investing Earlier Than They Did
videos.description: Bloomberg's Josyana Joshua joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." Many parents are opening accounts that let teens learn the basics of investing with their supervision, in hopes of teaching them about investing early. As a result, financial firms have noticed and are rolling out products designed to appeal to parents and teens, such as joint brokerage accounts and parental-managed accounts that invest in exchange-traded funds. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
